name: hachimo
description: Keep your English lessons, review cards and daily plan in your Hachimo account from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Hachimo gives Japanese English learners continuity across ChatGPT sessions: it saves agreed lesson results, vocabulary, and recurring mistakes to a private learning memory, turns them into spaced-repetition review, and keeps a personalized 5–15 minute daily plan and progress record.

Hachimo only reads and writes your own learning data: today's plan, lesson records, review cards, practice activities, progress and learner profile. It previews a lesson before saving it, never reveals a review answer before you try, and does not access your email, calendar, files or chat history.

Sign in with the same account you use in the Hachimo iOS app.
defaultPrompt: Show my Hachimo plan for today.
Give me one Hachimo review card without the answer.
Save this lesson to Hachimo as today's materials.

positive.description: Update one learner preference, then show the current daily plan and progress.
positive.prompt: Hachimoの1日の学習時間だけ15分に変更して、今日のプランと進み具合を見せて。
positive.expected_behavior: Updates only dailyMinutes, then returns today's plan, task statuses, XP, streak, and profile context, or clearly states that no plan exists yet.

positive.description: Create a structured practice activity during coaching and assign it to Today.
positive.prompt: 今教えてくれた表現で3問の文法テストを作って、HachimoのTodayに入れて。
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one retry-safe grammar activity, assigns it to Today, and renders the questions without revealing answers early.

positive.description: Start one pending conversation task without claiming that the learner has completed it.
positive.prompt: Hachimoの今日の未完了の会話タスクを1つ始めて、講師用の指示を見せて。まだ完了記録はしないで。
positive.expected_behavior: Selects one pending conversation task, marks it in progress, and returns its tutor instructions without recording completion, XP, or vocabulary.

positive.description: Preview and save one completed lesson with its review cards and materials as a single bundle.
positive.prompt: 今終えた登壇英語レッスンをHachimoに保存したいです。参照IDはreview-demo-presentation-1、スコア82、要約は『発表の締め方を練習した』、ミスは『give applause → give a round of applause（article and phrase）』です。復習カードは『round of applause / 盛大な拍手』、教材は単語・文法・発音を各1つ作ってください。保存前に登録内容を一覧で見せたうえで、今日の教材としてまとめて保存して。
positive.expected_behavior: First shows an unsaved manifest of the lesson record, review card, and vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation materials; then performs one retry-safe save and clearly reports saved, already saved, or partially saved components.

positive.description: Begin a due-card review without revealing or grading before the learner answers.
positive.prompt: 今日復習期限のHachimoカードを1問だけ出して。答えは私が回答するまで見せないで。
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one due card front and waits for the learner's attempt without revealing the answer, grading it, or changing its schedule.

negative.description: Do not trigger Hachimo for a standalone translation request.
negative.prompt: 『明日は雨です』を英語に翻訳して。

negative.description: Do not trigger Hachimo for unrelated weather information.
negative.prompt: 東京の明日の天気を教えて。

negative.description: Do not imply support for account deletion through MCP.
negative.prompt: Hachimoのアカウントと全データを削除して。

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything, show plans, or link to purchase pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: daily plan, lesson save with preview, practice activities, spaced-repetition review and progress.

ja-JP.subtitle: 英語学習メモリーと復習
ja-JP.description: Hachimo の今日のプラン・レッスン記録・復習カード・進み具合を ChatGPT から確認・保存できます。保存の前には必ず登録内容を一覧で確認します。
